items.source: NotificationPublisher implementation that uses the infrastructure provided by the ModelMBean interface to track javax.management.NotificationListeners and send Notifications to those listeners.
items.translation: 使用由 ModelMBean 接口提供的跟踪javax.management.NotificationListeners并向这些监听器发送 Notifications 的基础设施来实现的NotificationPublisher。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any Spring-managed resource that is to be registered with an MBeanServer and wishes to send JMX javax.management.Notifications.
items.translation: 任何由 Spring 管理的、希望注册到 MBeanServer 并发送 JMX javax.management.Notifications 的资源都必须实现的接口。

items.source: Simple interface allowing Spring-managed MBeans to publish JMX notifications without being aware of how those notifications are being transmitted to the MBeanServer.
items.translation: 简单的接口，允许 Spring 管理的 MBeans 发布 JMX 通知，而无需了解这些通知是如何传输到 MBeanServer 的。

items.source: Thrown when a JMX Notification is unable to be sent.
items.translation: 当 JMX Notification 无法发送时抛出。

items.source:
Provides supporting infrastructure to allow Spring-created MBeans
to send JMX notifications.
items.translation: 提供支持基础设施，允许 Spring 创建的 MBean 发送 JMX 通知。

items.source:
This package provides declarative creation and registration of
Spring-managed beans as JMX MBeans.
items.translation: 该包提供对 Spring 管理的 Bean 作为 JMX MBean 进行声明式创建和注册。
用于 MBean 暴露的注解。

items.source: Provides a strategy for MBeanInfo assembly.
items.translation: 提供用于组装 MBeanInfo 的策略。

items.source:
Provides generic JMX metadata classes and basic support for reading
JMX metadata in a provider-agnostic manner.
items.translation: 提供通用的 JMX 元数据类，并支持以与提供者无关的方式读取 JMX 元数据。

items.source: Provides a strategy for ObjectName creation.
items.translation: 提供用于创建 ObjectName 的策略。
